identitySignals: The agenda name 'University of Kansas Center for Research, Inc.' exactly matches the registered nonprofit in ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (EIN 48-0680117). It is listed in Lawrence, KS.
The agenda location, Lawrence, KS, matches the organization's registry city and its mailing address on the University of Kansas (KU) Nichols Hall page.

The KU Office of Research page says KUCR is a nonprofit foundation that manages research grants and contracts for KU. That fits a services agreement for academic programs handled through KU. I found no public page linking KUCR to Oakland Unified, so this match rests on the exact name and the city.
research.notes: The phone is listed on the Nichols page as the KUCR receptionist line. The email ovcr@ku.edu is the general Office of Research address, which is where KUCR is administered. The KUCR address, 2385 Irving Hill Road (Youngberg Hall), comes from the KU Nichols Hall page. Charity Navigator lists a different registry address, 1450 Jayhawk Blvd Room 245. No California Secretary of State entity number or SAM.gov UEI was checked or found. The legacy KUCR page at www2.ku.edu could not be fetched, so it is not cited.

profile.legalName: University of Kansas Center for Research, Inc.
profile.summary: The University of Kansas Center for Research, Inc. (KUCR) is a nonprofit research foundation that operates for the benefit of the University of Kansas. It manages research grants and contracts, and helps run sponsored research and service projects. It operates under the administrative oversight of the university's Office of Research.

sources.title: University Of Kansas Center For Research Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: This is the same organization. The agenda name exactly matches the 501(c)(3) on ProPublica (EIN 48-0680117, Lawrence, KS), and the KU Office of Research page describes KUCR as a nonprofit foundation that runs KU's sponsored programs, which fits a services agreement with a KU academic program. The cited pages support every field: the summary, the KUCR receptionist phone, and the Youngberg Hall mailing address. The website and email belong to the Office of Research, which administers KUCR, rather than to KUCR itself.
